about: Per-light decisions for the P02 scores REVERT (lighting_scores_apply.py, 'Per-light drift decisions'). One entry per drifted light the drift report could NOT attribute (class UNKNOWN = inferred hand edit). Attributed drift (RIG_LAMP_DROP etc.) is not decided here: revert that tool first.
how_to_decide: Set each 'decision' to keep / overwrite / fold (see that light's 'options'), then set status to DECIDED and decided_by to who decided (Gary). Leave row_hash alone: it pins the live row this decision is about; REVERT refuses if the light changed since.

options.keep: REVERT leaves this score lamp in the Show WITH your edit; a later APPLY of P02 then refuses SCORE_ALREADY_PRESENT until the lamp is removed by hand
options.overwrite: REVERT removes the lamp as usual; your edit is discarded (a re-APPLY authors the score's own value)
options.fold: NOT POSSIBLE: FOLD_FIELD_UNSUPPORTED|P02 SCORE B01 THEATRICAL BEAM_R|field=relative_transform.rotation_xyzw|the score cannot author it (aims are computed; flags/materials are look data): choose keep or overwrite
